metadata.summary: Governed working candidates with durable domain request replay, stable IDs and bounded retrieval.

semantics.description: Create requires payload requestKey (8–128 ASCII letters/digits/dot/underscore/hyphen, first alphanumeric). This is domain operation data, NEVER authority. Host idempotency is none: no CallOptions.idempotencyKey is accepted, no Host result/error replay cache. Domain MUST durably bind trusted actor plus operation namespace plus requestKey to normalized complete mutation payload and original result, atomically with mutation/audit, for at least 86400000ms from commit across provider/Host restart. Every attempt reauthorizes current Host grants AND trusted actor/data-root/domain permission before any replay. Same key changed payload is CONFLICT; actor namespace is isolated; original stable ID/result retained. Explicit retry after ambiguous write uses same payload key; no automatic retry or rollback claim. Get/search remain unchanged. See SEMANTICS.md and CHANGE.md. Proposed redesign, not reviewed/admitted.

proposal.problem: An external project worker must create one scoped working note with attributable provenance, retrieve its stable ID, search it, stop/restart the provider, then retrieve it again without direct HTTP/database/framework coupling.
proposal.existingInsufficient: Frozen echo is side-effect-free; example.records is opaque replaceable key/value without governed scope/provenance/candidate semantics or search. Agent-execution and decision-evaluate do not provide durable governed memory. Changing their semantics is prohibited.
proposal.abstraction: One generic working-candidate capability create/get/search. Breaking v2 adds mandatory requestKey to create payload and disables Host-level idempotency; persistence is an explicit normative shared-domain guarantee, not an instance cache claim. No new public binding/platform or domain promotion/import authority.
providers: Governed MemoryV4 shared-domain SQLite adapter (authorized planned implementation, not yet built)
Any independent governed candidate provider satisfying these public semantics; no requirement to implement one speculatively
consumers: External public-SDK project working-note consumer; create/get/search/restart/get with no MemoryV4, FastAPI or SQLite imports
proposal.alternatives: Original durable Host policy is rejected by frozen public Host and ContractProvider. Merely instance relabeling rejected: Host caches success/errors and can bypass current domain reauthorization. Revised v2 uses domain requestKey and transport idempotency none so every call reaches current authority checks. No Kernel/ACAP/Foundation edits.
proposal.security: Trusted Host caller mapped by operator to actor/data-root/permitted domain operations on EVERY attempt; requestKey is non-authoritative request data. No caller identity/grants in payload. Current domain create authorization precedes durable replay. Same-actor key conflicts on changed scope/content; distinct actor namespace cannot replay another actor result. Retry is explicit after ambiguity; committed mutation and ledger are atomic; no automatic retries or rollback promises.
proposal.scopes: Existing application/session Catalog labels and Host scope/grants unchanged. Requested memory scope must equal/descend separately mapped data-root; visible ancestor candidates only; no public opt-in or sibling leakage. Catalog permission metadata grants nothing.
proposal.compatibility: Breaking additive v2 draft, different major and digest. Original reviewed v1 files/receipt remain unchanged; their review/admission does not transfer. Consumer moves from CallOptions.idempotencyKey to payload.requestKey; v1 and v2 never silently resolve as compatible. Existing HTTP API unchanged. Minimum durability remains24h and restart-stable replay; Host generic replay guarantee is explicitly not offered.
proposal.genericRationale: Scoped attributable working text candidates and lexical retrieval are reusable across project workers/providers; no tenant names, MemoryV4 endpoints or SQLite representation in the contract.

review.rationale: Parent independently read revised semantics/change explanation, definition/proposal, preparation, provider and five diagnostic tests/capture, verified all ten packet SHA256 against review request, and inspected shared-domain create_record plus Store create_record_idempotent/_idempotency_replay/_save_idempotency. Reviewed descriptor digest sha256:286159e1a40284cc02aa67cd2ab2cf4d1092733260c406f5a1810df2891be033. Abstraction accepted: bounded create/get/search with explicit domain request identity is generic and does not introduce a platform. Security accepted: no Host replay cache, every attempt receives current Host and domain authorization; actor-scoped transactional request/result ledger and audit preserve restart replay and explicit reconciliation after response loss. RequestKey is data, not authority. Namespace prefix is not an isolation boundary against same-actor authorized HTTP calls, as explicitly documented. Scopes accepted: unchanged requested target narrowing, actor isolation, hidden-data protection and no promotion/import grants. Compatibility accepted as explicitly BREAKING major2 with required payload key, old CallOptions key rejected; never silent alias/downgrade. Original v1 packet/review remains immutable evidence of blocked design. Required durability is retained as a normative domain guarantee, not falsely attributed to Host. Original receipt replay differs deliberately from current-state reads; original result never re-promotes or restores data. Replay ledger is authoritative for same-domain restart/recovery and must not be marked rebuildable, even though fresh-domain graph import excludes it. Accelerated25h-age fixture plus no-eviction source inspection is not a wall-clock soak. Five diagnostic tests are design feasibility evidence, not complete M11/M12 or final release conformance. Accept revised design for PROPOSED via existing reviewProposal only. Integrate bounded mapping, revalidate revised preimplementation manifest fixture, then actual conformance/evidence-backed EXPERIMENTAL admission and pinned real-snapshot validation before release qualification. Preserve transaction rollback/commit ambiguity, reauthorization, retention, exact stable IDs and audit requirements in integrated tests. No Kernel/Foundation/public-contract changes, production actions or closed live grants authorized. Final independent release review remains required.
